I am running the final verification of `org.mockitointegration.NoJUnitDependenciesTest::pure_mockito_should_not_depend_JUnit`.
The issue has been resolved.

### Cause of Bug
In [`VerificationOverTimeImpl.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/mockito_5_group_a_blind/src/org/mockito/internal/verification/VerificationOverTimeImpl.java#L91), the catch block specifically caught `org.mockito.exceptions.verification.junit.ArgumentsAreDifferent`. This class extends `org.junit.ComparisonFailure`, introducing a direct dependency on JUnit. When pure Mockito API classes are loaded in an environment without JUnit on the classpath (as tested by [`NoJUnitDependenciesTest.pure_mockito_should_not_depend_JUnit`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/mockito_5_group_a_blind/test/org/mockitointegration/NoJUnitDependenciesTest.java#L14)), class verification failed with `NoClassDefFoundError`.

### Fix
Replaced `catch (org.mockito.exceptions.verification.junit.ArgumentsAreDifferent e)` with `catch (AssertionError e)` in [`VerificationOverTimeImpl.verify`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/mockito_5_group_a_blind/src/org/mockito/internal/verification/VerificationOverTimeImpl.java#L88-L94). Because both `MockitoAssertionError` and JUnit's `ComparisonFailure` extend `AssertionError`, this decouples Mockito's core verification logic from JUnit.

The fix has been verified and saved to [blind_fix.patch](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/mockito_5_group_a_blind/blind_fix.patch).
